# Barro-Lee educational attainment: version 3 (1950-2015) and the long-run series of Education Matters (1870-2010), adults aged 25-64

External reference, no bytes stored. Publisher: Robert J. Barro and Jong-Wha Lee (barrolee.com, GitHub repository barrolee/BarroLeeDataSet). Source: https://github.com/barrolee/BarroLeeDataSet.

The repository that serves barrolee.com carries an MIT licence file, but the site footer reads "All rights reserved", so redistribution is left unresolved and no bytes are kept here. The consumer downloads two CSV files from one fixed commit and checks their SHA-256. BL_v3_MF2564.csv: attainment of the total population aged 25-64, 146 countries, 1950-2015 at five-year intervals (version 3, September 2021, with the revised 2015 estimate for the United States). OUP_long_MF2564_v1.csv: the long-run series built for Barro and Lee (2015), Education Matters, chapter 2, total population aged 25-64, 89 countries, 1870-2010 at five-year intervals. Cite Barro and Lee (2013), Journal of Development Economics 104, 184-198, for version 3, and Barro and Lee (2015), Education Matters (Oxford University Press), for the long-run series.
